title: SC-NeuroCore: A Deterministic Stochastic Computing Framework for Neuromorphic Hardware Design
description: SC-NeuroCore is a research toolkit for stochastic computing and spiking neural networks. It provides deterministic bitstream simulation, selected Python and Rust model paths, hardware-oriented intermediate representations, RTL generation and co-simulation collateral, and explicit validation boundaries. The repository README contains a generated inventory for each exact source tree; hardware performance and scientific fidelity require separate evidence.
notes: Part of the SCPN (Self-Consistent Phenomenological Network) research framework by ANULUM.
